title: Require Service Public Consumer Sealing
forbids: a literal module-loading edge from an app, package, plugin, resource, tool, or sibling service to a standalone service's private implementation alias or a syntactically visible src/service tree path
why: A standalone service crosses its package boundary through its deliberate public client face. Owner-local source and proof may consume private implementation aliases, while foreign consumers remain sealed from directly named service DTOs, schemas, middleware, models, repositories, ports, and implementation files.
remediate: Import the service's public client face instead of a #<owner>-service/* alias or a literal path that visibly enters services/<owner>/src/service. Keep private aliases inside the matching top-level services/<owner> package; adapt or derive public capability contracts through the public face rather than reaching into implementation.
message: Standalone service implementation trees are private to their owning package.
